mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points from the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to quality and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in housing starts signals a supply chain disruption followed by a housing sector rebound, creating a positive feedback loop for corporate earnings and driving S&P 500 returns upward over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: supply chain disruption and housing rebound
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines and HOUST rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-demand regime (RSAFS above 95th percentile of 12-month average), a decline in retail sales below 95% of the prior three-month low signals a demand shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 95th percentile of 12-month average AND RSAFS < 0.95 * 3-month rolling low
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production below 98% of the prior month's level indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate earnings visibility and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 0.98 * prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts and a rise in retail sales indicates a shift in consumer demand from housing to goods, increasing economic uncertainty and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST declines and RSAFS rises, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in non-farm payroll employment over three consecutive months indicates a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending power and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has declined for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
